sentences.show: The Berlin Wall stood for 28 years. It fell because a spokesman misread a note.
It happened on this night in 1989.
East Germany had decided to let its people cross the border more freely, starting the next day.
Party spokesman Günter Schabowski was handed the note just before a live press conference. No one told him the details.
He read it out. A reporter asked: when does it take effect?
He hesitated, and said: "As far as I know… immediately. Without delay."
West German TV broadcast it that evening: the border is open.
Thousands rushed to the crossings. The guards had no orders.
At 11:30 pm, at Bornholmer Street, an officer named Harald Jäger opened the gates.
East Berliners poured through, and were met with flowers and champagne.
By morning, people were chipping the Wall apart with hammers.
Also on this day: Garry Kasparov became world chess champion at twenty-two, and the raider Emden was finally caught.
